summary: XPeng Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (Stock Code 9868) and NYSE-listed EV maker, filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange announcement of a routine equity incentive grant. On October 16, 2026 the board granted 4,591,246 restricted share units, each representing one Class A ordinary share, to 75 employees at nil purchase price under the 2025 Share Incentive Scheme; the closing price that day was HK$37.460 per share. No shareholder approval is required and no director, chief executive or substantial shareholder is a grantee. Shares vest on service-based schedules through October 2030. This is an ordinary compensation event, not a special situation; watch only for dilution creep.
